oracle-l5r-10493.note: Asako Usohara (Personality, Emperor Edition, issue #699): "Limited, bow: Search your Dynasty discard pile, then deck, for a Fudo Celestial. Put it into play." and "Limited: Put a Fudo Ring from your hand into play. This counts as playing it by its own text. Remove Usohara from the game." The second line is now buildable (the Ring-entry record of WlRings.cs takes an own-text entry with Usohara as source), but the first needs a search whose destination is IN PLAY for a Celestial (Zone.Celestial entry from the Dynasty discard pile or deck, honouring Unique and the Celestial's entry rules); the search catalogue's destinations are hand, province, holding and Ring-into-play only. A card with two printed lines is wired whole or blocked. Needs a search-to-Celestial-in-play destination.

oracle-l5r-10561.note: The False Path (Stronghold, issue #699): "You may not win by Enlightenment" is now a one-line read of the Ring-entry primitive's Enlightenment check, but the card is a whole Stronghold: its non-Unique Monk and Fudo Personalities gain Monk and Fudo in and out of play, Fudo Personalities join for 2 less Gold, Honor Requirements of Fudo cards are ignored, no Honor is lost from owned Fudo cards, and a Limited bow search for a Fudo Ring. Granting keywords to cards out of play and the Fudo Honor waivers are separate primitives, and no stronghold scan is packaged in the rings waves.
